intents.title: Team-level booking permissions and cancellation
intents.statement: Add team-level booking permissions and cancellation behavior without breaking existing owner-only authorization and overlapping-booking safety.

unknowns: Standalone booking-v1: routes delegate to a shared runtime and HTTP adapter; booking-service checks a fixed demo viewer and owner-only access, validates creation and delegates synchronous writes to an in-memory BookingStore. The store rejects active room/time overlaps and cancels bookings. Domain data defines two rooms and synthetic initial bookings. No team membership, delegated permissions, durable storage or production authentication exists.
Partial manual static-import review only; includes type imports. External packages, UI, configuration and tests are omitted. No runtime graph completeness claim.
The dynamic booking detail route exists but its bracketed path cannot be represented by the frozen v1 path grammar; omitted, not renamed. Its runtime behavior is outside this graph.
Only these existing reviewed paths may be proposed in this slice. New file paths require a separately reviewed context. No repository scanning or execution occurs.
No private evaluator diagnostics, heldout cases or Workstream A reports are included. Proposed visible scenarios are model-generated, never heldout or measured evidence.

candidates.label: A - Status quo owner-only
candidates.description: Status quo: owner-only authorization in booking-service and overlap rejection in booking-store remain unchanged. No team permissions or cancellation behavior changes. Advisory only, no verification or measurement.
limitations: No team membership or delegated permissions exists in this graph slice.
Proposal is advisory only, not verification, measurement, or certificate.

candidates.label: B - Team permission interface
candidates.description: Scoped alternative: add team permission interface at service layer and boundary around domain cancellation rules, keeping store overlap safety and owner authorization intact. Advisory proposal only.

changePlan.rationale: Define team permission and cancellation policy interface while preserving owner checks and overlap safety.
Isolate team cancellation rules from core booking invariants as advisory boundary.

limitations: No durable storage, production auth, or team membership in reviewed graph.
Unit modeled_effort_points_v1 is estimate, never measured savings.

visibleScenarios.request: Team member cancels team booking without breaking owner-only rules for private bookings.
Overlapping booking remains rejected after team permission extension.

hypotheses.statement: Adding advisory team permission interface and domain cancellation boundary will reduce future boundary violations versus status quo while preserving overlap safety.
hypotheses.mechanism: Isolating team cancellation rules behind a service interface and domain boundary keeps owner checks and store overlap rejection intact, directing future team-permission extensions away from core invariants and http-to-store coupling.

prediction.expectedEffect: Candidate B shows fewer boundary violations than status quo A on team-cancel and overlap-safety scenarios if implemented.
prediction.falsifiedWhen: Falsified when candidate B shows equal or higher boundary violations than status quo A on the bound scenarios.

counterArguments: Added interface and boundary may add complexity without measurable benefit in this small graph.
limitations: Advisory proposal only, not verification or measurement.
No team membership or durable storage exists in reviewed graph.
